project_type: Electron desktop app with Lit web components (no React/build step)
language: JavaScript (vanilla ES modules in renderer, CommonJS in main process)
build_system: No build step - Lit bundled as lit-core-2.7.4.min.js, loaded directly
verification_instructions: Verify syntax correctness via node --check on main-process files. Renderer files use ES module imports from bundled Lit so cannot be node-checked directly - verify no obvious syntax errors by inspection.
setup_instructions: npm install (optional since no build). App runs via electron .
environment_constraints: No npm available in sandbox for package install. No Electron runtime. Validate via AST/syntax checks only. No network access for package registries.
contribution_requirements: No npm packages allowed. Use existing CSS vars. Don't break typing system, stores, or services.
key_patterns: Lit components extend LitElement, use static styles/properties, import from ../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js. Main process uses CommonJS (require/module.exports). IPC communication between main/renderer via ipcRenderer.invoke and ipcRenderer.on. Global cheatingDaddy object in renderer. Event bus at window.cheatingDaddy.events (_eventBus). Storage uses JSON files in OS config dir with in-memory cache.
directory_structure: src/components/app/ - main app shell. src/components/views/ - page views. src/utils/ - renderer utilities, gemini API, prompts. src/stores/ - state stores. src/storage.js - main process storage module. src/typing/ - typing backend system. src/native/ - native modules.
